purpose: Resolves competing actions by priority when they share an input.
description: Lets multiple actions share an input and compete by score; every frame the enabled highest-scoring action becomes preferred for that input type.

Client/InputList/InputListScoreHelper.lu.description: Distributes the scored action to the correct providers based upon input mode Public entry points include `InputListScoreHelper.new`.

Client/Picker/ScoredActionPicker.luau.description: Scored Action Picker provides the class/model implementation used by the Scoredactionservice package. Public entry points include `ScoredActionPicker.new`, `ScoredActionPicker.Update`, `ScoredActionPicker.AddAction`, `ScoredActionPicker.RemoveAction`, `ScoredActionPicker.HasActions`.

Client/Picker/ScoredActionPickerProvider.description: Scored Action Picker Provider provides the class/model implementation used by the Scoredactionservice package. Public entry points include `ScoredActionPickerProvider.new`, `ScoredActionPickerProvider.FindPicker`, `ScoredActionPickerProvider.GetOrCreatePicker`, `ScoredActionPickerProvider.Update`.

Client/Picker/TouchButtonScoredActionPic.description: We need to handle touch buttons separately because we may have as many of these as we want. Public entry points include `TouchButtonScoredActionPicker.new`, `TouchButtonScoredActionPicker.Update`, `TouchButtonScoredActionPicker.AddAction`, `TouchButtonScoredActionPicker.RemoveAction`, `TouchButtonScoredActionPicker.HasActions`.

Client/ScoredAction.luau.description: An action that has a score, and may recieve priority from [ScoredActionServiceClient] Public entry points include `ScoredAction.new`, `ScoredAction.SetIsEnabled`, `ScoredAction.IsEnabled`, `ScoredAction.ObserveIsEnabled`, `ScoredAction.IsPreferred`, `ScoredAction.ObservePreferred`, `ScoredAction.SetScore`, `ScoredAction.GetScore`.

Client/ScoredActionServiceClient.luau.description: Scores actions and picks the highest rated one every frame. Public entry points include `ScoredActionServiceClient.Init`, `ScoredActionServiceClient.Start`, `ScoredActionServiceClient.GetScoredAction`, `ScoredActionServiceClient.ObserveNewFromInputKeyMapList`, `ScoredActionServiceClient.Destroy`.
